question: Does verified computation augmentation improve ordinary real-document prediction beyond matched raw CPT,and separately does self-generated computation improve prediction at inference?
models: One fresh released Qwen3-1.7B-Base per arm per seed;one shared causal model generates and consumes its computation. No separate trained writer-reader pair.

arms.real_raw: Native prefix+actual future16;ordinary token CE,source fragment has no artificial EOS.
arms.real_prior: One raw and one augmented occurrence per document across2passes. Augmented:prefix+GIVEN Calculation opening+verified full trace including root+Answer marker+actual future16. Opening marker is unscored;all other declared targets share one CE mean.
arms.real_post: One raw and one augmented occurrence per document across2passes. Augmented:prefix+actual future16+GIVEN Calculation opening+verified full trace+native EOS. Trace is an offline training scaffold,not a prefix-only policy claim.

training.checkpoints: Full state at160and320 or explicit STOP; terminal320 is primary. No outcome-based checkpoint choice or training extension.
training.source_order: Same seed-specific document permutation per arm;eachdocument exactlyoneplainandoneaugmentedview in augmentationarms;rawcontroltwoordinaryviews

primary_training.contrast: real_post.raw minus real_raw.raw,full native16-token summed log likelihood on novel-expression256,paired over documents.
primary_training.pass: Gain>=0.25nat/span and95%paired bootstrap lower>0 in eachseed. Ordinary-DEV256 mean tokenNLL increase<=0.02nat and95%upper<=0.05nat relative to raw-control. Report every arm and B0 absolute paths;do not call an improvement over degraded CPT a new best base model.

primary_inference.contrast: real_prior.generated minus real_raw.raw,full native16-token summed log likelihood on the same novel256.
primary_inference.pass: Gain>=0.25nat/span and95%lower>0 in eachseed;own-minus-same-model raw and own-minus-empty also have positive95%lower. This gate is independent of the training-benefit gate.
primary_inference.policy: Prefix-only generation from nativeprefix+Calculation opening,cap128. Stop at first generated Answer boundary or nativeEOS;retain all actual content up to cap. Fixed Answer boundary closes the reader context as needed. Score actual future16 only afterwards. No target-dependent note selection,repair or replacement;include caps/errors and forced closure in reports and cost.
primary_inference.controls: B0,eachtrainedrawpath,emptyformat,generatedown,intactunrelated,andverifiedsuppliedfulltrace. Full CoT is the single-model prior/full-trace reference. Supplied trace may include root answer and is not deployed-policy evidence.

secondary_endpoints: Complete scalar accuracy only with declared parser and allunsupported counts;likelihood remains primary.
Genuine generated tokens,cap/empty/stop/forcedclose counts;native128tracebudget plus32continuation versus160single-stream allowance.
Actual supervised labels,unique documents,repeated exposures,chip-time and measured latency separately;equalupdatesarenotequalFLOPs.
statistics: 20,000 paired document bootstrap draws,seed2026101915,95% percentile intervals. Report the two training seeds separately. These unadjusted intervals condition on checkpoints and do not measure training-seed uncertainty.
launch_gates: CPU/source packing and actual8rank width640 native/BF16/master/finiteupdate/fullcheckpoint/fresh-process recovery/memory qualification first. Main science loader requires the exact pinned same-source/same-shape PASS receipt. Separate finite resource release before any320update job;qualification weights excluded.
limitations: Selected verified FineMath arithmetic documents are a bridge,not general-language or officialTEST evidence.
Source equation acceptance uses observed truth,but calculation labels are interpreted from the causal prefix alone.
Root calculation and answer are included for competitive single-model supervision;this is not intermediate-only assistance proof.
OrdinaryCE and one raw/oneaugmented view are a specified adaptation,not an exact TPT or BoLT reproduction.
Opening markers are supplied conditions;they are excluded from ordinary next-token labels.
Raw/prior/post have different supervised-token counts and effective per-token weights despite matching documents/updates.
A failed inference gate does not erase an independent training benefit,and vice versa.
No8B or broadRL launch;splitcurriculumrepair remains bounded diagnostic,not mainline.
